description: This file contains integration tests for the Create Catalog Item endpoint of the public API in the eShopOnWeb project. The tests verify authorization behavior and successful creation of catalog items with valid data and tokens.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: A test class that contains integration tests for the Create Catalog Item API endpoint, focusing on authorization and successful item creation.

methods.name: ReturnsNotAuthorizedGivenNormalUserToken
methods.description: Test method ensuring that a normal user token receives a 403 Forbidden response when attempting to create a catalog item.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidNewItemAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Test method validating that an admin user token successfully creates a catalog item and returns correct item details.

methods.name: GetValidNewItemJson
methods.description: Helper method that serializes a sample create catalog item request as JSON content for HTTP POST.
